title: AnaTele: evidence-first investigation of ArduPilot flight logs
description:
AnaTele is an open-source desktop tool for investigating ArduPilot flight logs (.tlog, .bin, .log). It infers flight phases, replays the recorded path in 3D, evaluates a versioned declarative rule pack with four explicit result states, and ranks competing failure hypotheses by capped evidence-family support minus contradictions, without assigning probabilities. Every finding links to the exact log record. It includes a fault-injection quadcopter simulator and a hash-verified shareable analysis format (.ant).

Documentation: avinashistoocool.github.io/AnaTele
